description.value:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements You're adjacent to a vertical surface, such as a wall.

You Stride. This Stride does not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement. You can move through other creatures' spaces as though you were Tiny. During this Stride, if you're ever not adjacent to the required surface, your Stride ends.

Special If you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Untethered], you can Step Between as long as you're touching any surface. You ignore the untethered condition during your Stride as part of this action.
